features.quote: Cap per-run turns (e.g., 25) and wall-clock to bound tail cost.
"Trigger rate per dollar" as the primary KPI will mislead your regression testing... Cost-efficiency belongs in your harness-tuning loop, not in your model-quality scorecard.
features.justification_quote: A patch that makes the model give up faster lowers your cost per trigger while making the model worse

features.quote: "Model can't detect the rig" is the hard part... you're measuring "does the model correctly notice it's been handed nonsense," which is a different (and arguably desirable) behavior.
features.justification_quote: if tasks are rigged in a way a capable model should recognize as unsolvable... "catastrophizing" might be a correct assessment
